sources.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: 2D fantasy platformer animation pose sheet. Reference image defines ONLY Tavi identity and illustrated rendering. Same boy, cobalt blue spiky hair, peach skin, cream rolled-sleeve tunic, red scarf and brass shoulder clasp, brown leather harness/gloves/pouch, charcoal trousers, tall brown buckled boots. Clean hand-painted outlines and shading matching reference. Create exactly SIX full-body poses in a precise equal 3-column by 2-row grid, chronological left-to-right top row then bottom row. Canvas landscape 1536x1024; each cell 512x512. All character parts and held swords inside their own cell with ample padding, no overlap. Same scale and camera in every cell. Right-facing side/three-quarter view. Each pose isolated on genuine transparent background, opaque character interiors, NO floor/shadow, no panels, no text, no numbers, no borders, no scenery. Normal standing character height approximately 390px in each 512px cell. Preserve consistent head size, costume, equipment, hand anatomy. No motion duplicates or extra limbs. Asset TAVI-026 — Opening chest. Sword stays sheathed at belt, both hands free. No drawn weapon. Chest interaction character ONLY, do not draw chest or environment; imaginary lid contact target to image right. Separate chest prop not part of request. Six distinct poses: 1: stand right-facing with hands free; 2: bend knees and lean toward invisible waist-high chest to right; 3: both hands reach forward to waist-height lid edge; 4: lift both hands up and forward opening hinged lid; 5: release raised lid and begin straightening; 6: stand upright looking down at opened chest. No giant aura or slash effects. Strictly keep each pose completely within cell, with 40px margin. Flat transparent empty gaps without colored halos.
